name: Sales outreach
blurb: From a target list to sent-by-hand messages and follow-ups, using the LinkedIn guides' research, message and safety rules.
description: Plan and write a sales outreach sequence from one request: find and score leads from allowed sources, pick an angle per person, draft connection notes and messages, and plan follow-ups, using the Skill Garden linkedin-automation and content-creation super skills in order. Everything is drafted for the user to send by hand. Use when asked to run outreach, prospect, write cold messages or plan follow-ups for a product or service.
ask: Run outreach for <offer> to <type of buyer>.
inputs: The offer and why it matters to this buyer
Who the buyer is (role, company type, size)
Leads you already have, or where to look
Proof: results, customers, numbers you can use
Daily volume you are comfortable sending by hand

steps.title: Research and score the leads
steps.output: A short scored list with one public, relevant signal per person.

steps.title: Pick the angle and proof
steps.output: The pain, the promise and the proof to lead with, per segment.

steps.title: Draft the messages
steps.output: A connection note and a first message per person, inside the character caps.

steps.title: Plan the follow-ups
steps.output: Two follow-ups per person with the day to send each, and when to stop.
